configurator.install_step_tip: Choose above ground, partially sunken or fully sunken. Glass, railing and external stair options depend on this.
configurator.equipment_tip: Select the technical equipment you want to add. The price updates as you go.
configurator.equipment_note: Equipment is not shown in the 3D preview; it is added to your quote.
configurator.eq_heat_pump_note: Keeps the water at your preferred temperature and extends the swimming season.
configurator.eq_swimjet_note: Adjustable current for endless swimming in a compact pool.
configurator.eq_dosing_note: Measures pH and chlorine and doses chemicals automatically.
configurator.eq_salt_note: Produces chlorine from salt, reducing chemicals and softening the water.
configurator.eq_blue_lagoon_note: Treats the water by destroying microorganisms with ultraviolet light.
configurator.finish_color_note: The pool interior is finished in the plain colour you choose.
configurator.finish_tile_note: The pool interior is clad with the ceramic tiles you choose.
configurator.sunken_notice: Railings, external stairs and glass panels are not used with a fully sunken installation. These selections were removed automatically and all panels were set to closed.
configurator.sunken_panels: With a fully sunken installation the panels are below ground; glass panels cannot be selected.
configurator.sunken_unavailable: Not available with a fully sunken installation.
configurator.solar_note: A solar panel array is fitted on top of the lift deck instead of the composite panel.
configurator.solar_hint: Solar panels are available only with the lift deck.
configurator.lift_note: A composite cover that moves up and down on corner posts. Lowered, it fully covers the pool; raised, it becomes a canopy.
configurator.lift_preview_hint: Select the lift deck in the Pool Features step to preview it.
configurator.entry_note: How to enter the pool: stainless ladder or tiled in-pool steps.
configurator.place_hint: Drag the pool to move it, choose its direction below
configurator.venue_desc: Which villa would you like to see your pool at? Turning on the lighting switches to the night view.
configurator.venue_1_desc: Minimalist modern villa with a wide porcelain terrace
configurator.venue_2_desc: Stone Mediterranean villa with a travertine courtyard
configurator.venue_3_desc: Contemporary villa with a large lawn
configurator.venue_4_desc: Contemporary villa with a wide wooden deck
configurator.install_note: Sunken installation places the pool into the ground; excavation and groundwork are planned separately.
configurator.stair_style_note: Block steps are closed risers in the body colour with wooden treads.
configurator.size_tip: Set the width and length of the pool in meters. Drag the sliders to see live 3D updates.
configurator.frame_tip: Choose the color of the steel frame. Anthracite is the standard finish; blue and white are decorative options.
configurator.panels_tip: First select the default type (glass or closed) for all panels, then set the segment count. Click any cell in the grid below to change individual panels.
configurator.options_tip: Enable or disable optional features like waterfall, side platform, outer extension, and ladder from this step.
configurator.lighting_tip: Underwater LED + pool-surround LED strip. When enabled, the scene switches to night mode. RGB option creates a live colour-cycle animation.
configurator.ground_tip: Choose the ground type around the pool. Preview it live in the 3D scene.
configurator.finish_tip: Select the cladding pattern for the interior floor of the pool.
configurator.preview_tip: Preview the pool with or without water.
configurator.summary_tip: Review your selections. If everything looks right, press 'Get Quote' to submit your request.
configurator.waterfall_note: A curved stainless steel water curtain placed on the short side of the pool.
configurator.cover_note: A slatted roller pool cover that slides closed over the water surface.
configurator.cover_preview_hint: Add the pool cover in step 4 (Options) to use this preview.
configurator.ext_note: Open platform strip beyond the equipment room (legs + railing). When disabled, the platform only extends to the equipment room width.
configurator.ladder_note: Stainless steel entry ladder inside the pool.
configurator.lighting_note: The scene automatically switches to night mode when lighting is on.
configurator.ground_note: The selected ground type updates live in the 3D scene.
configurator.quote_subtitle: Our team will contact you as soon as possible.
configurator.region_desc: Choose where your pool will be delivered — size limits are set automatically.
configurator.region_note: Size limits may vary based on shipping conditions.
